dei.evidence: People deserve to be heard and to have a voice — even when that means defending the right of people we disagree with.

community.evidence: Give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together.

shareholders.evidence: Our tools level the playing field so businesses grow, create jobs and strengthen the economy.

integrity.evidence: We have a responsibility to promote the best of what people can do together by keeping people safe and preventing harm.

safety.evidence: Keep People Safe and Protect Privacy We have a responsibility to promote the best of what people can do together by keeping people safe and preventing harm.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, mission-led framing in largely third-person and plural 'we' voice, with principles described as beliefs 'we hold deeply and make tradeoffs to pursue.' Community and connection lead; safety and privacy appear as a principle. Business-scale statistics and history dominate the page, which is largely factual description rather than commitments.
